messages.body:

Thanks.

The forms concern eligibility for work. They do not establish occupational causation.

threads.subject: Tomorrow
threads.narrativePurpose: Personal workplace relationship and incomplete schedule context; no automatic evidence or solution.

messages.body:
Hey,

I had to leave early today and went down to Medical.

I'm still on the schedule for tomorrow. Can you check if somebody's covering it? I don't want anyone ending up alone down there because I didn't say anything.

Sorry,
Jessica

I'll deal with the schedule.

Don't worry about finding someone tonight. Hope you're feeling better.
messages.subject: Re: Tomorrow

Tito
